label: controller
note: Role defined functionally ('determines the purposes and means'), not constituted as an office; criteria for nomination may be set by Union or Member State law (Art.4(7)).

label: processor
note: Role defined functionally ('processes on behalf of the controller').

label: data subject
note: Identified or identifiable natural person; category defined in the definition of 'personal data'.

label: recipient
note: Category; public authorities receiving data in a particular inquiry under Union/Member State law are not 'recipients'.

label: third party
note: Residual category.

label: representative (of controller/processor in the Union)
note: Designated in writing by the controller or processor pursuant to Art.27; instance created by the designation, not by the Regulation.

label: supervisory authority
legal_multiplicity: one or more per Member State (Art.51(1)) — to be checked at Art.51
note: Defined as an 'independent public authority which is established by a Member State pursuant to Article 51'. The Regulation does not itself constitute any national authority (N2, see Art.51). No national instance created.

label: supervisory authority concerned
note: Relational category (establishment of controller/processor; affected data subjects; complaint lodged) — role assigned by facts, not by designation.

label: main establishment
note: Locational/organizational category used to allocate competence (Art.56); not an institution.

label: binding corporate rules
note: Defined as data protection policies adhered to by a controller/processor within a group; approval by supervisory authority is regulated in Art.47. Device status to be assessed at Art.47 (DEV threshold).

label: international organisation
note: Category used for transfers (Chapter V).

label: holder of parental responsibility
note: Category in whose consent/authorization the processing of a child's data depends.

label: official authority (controlling processing of criminal-conviction data)
note: 'Control of official authority' is a condition on processing; no institution is named or constituted.

label: European Commission
note: Institution constituted by the Treaties, not by the GDPR; no external reference is made to the Treaties in the unit.

label: European Data Protection Board
establishment_norm_type: N1 (Art.68(1)) — to be checked at Art.68
note: Referred to in Art.35(4) as 'the Board referred to in Article 68'. | Only institutional body in the text whose establishment is stated by an N1 provision (to be confirmed at the end of the extraction).

label: data protection officer
establishment_norm_type: N2-designation (Art.37(1)) — to be checked at Arts 37–39
note: Office specified at type level; instances are designated by controllers/processors.

label: joint controllers (category)
note: Two or more controllers jointly determining purposes and means; role arises by fact, 'shall be joint controllers'.

label: approved code of conduct (Art.40)
note: Scheme regulated in Arts 40–41; device status assessed in Section 5.

label: approved certification mechanism (Art.42)
note: Scheme regulated in Arts 42–43; device status assessed in Section 5.

label: standard contractual clauses (Art.28(7)-(8))
note: Instrument adopted by the Commission or by a supervisory authority; typed characteristic of the controller–processor contract unless a distinct scheme is shown.

label: consistency mechanism (Art.63)
note: Procedure among supervisory authorities, the Board and the Commission, regulated in Arts 63–67 (Chapter VII); referenced here. | Bundle of procedures (opinion of the Board, dispute resolution, urgency procedure, information exchange) operated by SAs, the Board and the Commission.

label: association or body representing categories of controllers or processors
note: Private collective bodies; instances not created.

label: code-monitoring body (accredited, Art.41)
establishment_norm_type: N0 (position type specified; instances arise by accreditation by the competent SA)
note: Body with expertise, accredited by the competent supervisory authority to monitor compliance with a code of conduct.

label: certification body (Art.43)
establishment_norm_type: N0 (type specified; instances arise by accreditation)
note: Issues and renews certification; accredited by the competent SA and/or by the national accreditation body.

label: national accreditation body (named under Regulation (EC) No 765/2008)
note: Position type referenced; constitution depends on Regulation (EC) No 765/2008 (EXT).

label: register of approved codes of conduct, amendments and extensions (Board)
establishment_norm_type: N2 (obligation to collate in a register — not N1)
note: Duty of the Board to collate and publish; the register is not 'established' by an N1 provision in this unit.

label: register of certification mechanisms and data protection seals and marks (Board)
establishment_norm_type: N2 (obligation to collate in a register — not N1)
note: Corrigendum 2018 removes the parallel Board-register sentence from Art.43(6); the register duty remains in 42(8).

label: European Data Protection Seal (common certification)
establishment_norm_type: N4/N3-like (possible outcome: 'this may result in a common certification')
note: Named common certification that may result where criteria are approved by the Board.

label: third country, territory or sector; international organisation (transfer destinations)
note: Categories of destinations; their own authorities (Art.45(2)(b)) are third-country bodies outside W.

label: lead supervisory authority
note: Role of the supervisory authority of the main/single establishment for cross-border processing; assigned by facts, not by designation.

label: member(s) of a supervisory authority
note: Office-holders; appointed under Member State law (Arts 53–54).

label: appointing institution (parliament, government, head of State, or independent body under Member State law)
note: Four alternative appointing categories named; instances in Member State law (outside W).

label: national parliament, government and other institutions/authorities (Member State)
note: Addressees of advice (Art.57(1)(c)) and annual reports (Art.59); 'other authorities as designated by Member State law'.

label: judicial authorities / courts (Member State)
note: Constituted by Member State law; referred to in Arts 55(3), 58(5) and the remedies chapter.

label: lead-authority cooperation procedure (Art.60)
establishment_norm_type: N0 (procedure rules set out directly; no 'hereby established')
note: Procedure with identity (Art.60), operators (lead and concerned SAs) and rules (deadlines, objection, deemed agreement).

label: mutual assistance (Art.61)
note: Procedure among SAs; identity, rules (one month, grounds for refusal), operators.

label: joint operations (Art.62)
note: Procedure among SAs with right to participate.

label: urgency procedure (Art.66)
note: Derogation from Arts 60 and 63–65.

label: Chair of the Board
note: Office within the Board (Arts 73–74).

label: European Data Protection Supervisor
note: Member of the Board and provider of its secretariat; its constitution lies in another instrument (see Art.2(3)).

label: members of the Board (head of one supervisory authority of each Member State; the European Data Protection Supervisor; or their representatives)
note: Composition rule.

label: secretariat of the Board (provided by the European Data Protection Supervisor)
establishment_norm_type: N2/N1-mixed ('The Board shall have a secretariat, which shall be provided by the EDPS')
note: Entitlement-type wording; instance provided by another body (EDPS).

label: interested parties (consulted by the Board)
note: Unspecified category.

label: European Parliament and Council (addressees of the Board's annual report)
note: Union institutions constituted by the Treaties.

label: committee referred to in Art.93
note: Committee procedure (Regulation (EU) No 182/2011 via Art.93); constituted outside W.

label: public electronic register of decisions of supervisory authorities and courts handled in the consistency mechanism (Board)
note: Register duty of the Board; not stated as established.

label: not-for-profit body, organisation or association (Art.80)
note: Properly constituted under Member State law, statutory public-interest objectives, active in data protection; instances in national law.
